svg.title: Blueprint sheet 13, the bath: GDP counts how fast the tap runs, not how full the bath is

g.text: not how full the bath is
all that is made and sold.
what is left to live on:
what wears out or is used up.
paid to clean up a spill.
how much is made and sold
this year: what you need to
know in a slump or a war.
the old saying: not everything that counts can be counted.
the man who built it warned
a living blueprint for a world
